record.one_liner: Devin, Cognition's AI software engineering agent, with a v3 REST API for sessions, knowledge, playbooks and secrets plus an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Service user API keys (prefix cog_) or personal access tokens sent in the Authorization header. No OAuth flow documented. Keys expire after 7, 30 (default) or 90 days, or never where the account allows it. critic: confirmed against docs.devin.ai/api-reference/authentication.
record.access_notes: critic: access paid_plan kept. Service users are provisioned in Settings > Devin API of a Teams/Enterprise org. The self-serve docs describe the Free plan as limited Devin usage, Devin Review and DeepWiki only, with no API or cloud agents listed; the pricing page lists Devin Cloud and Devin API under paid tiers. No free or trial API path found, but the pricing table does not show per-plan cells, so this is inferred.
record.api_notes: Organization API at https://api.devin.ai/v3/organizations/* covers sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets and more. Enterprise API covers cross-org analytics, audit logs, users, billing.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict blocked kept. API keys come from a service user on a paid Teams or Enterprise org; Free plan lists no API access. Would become ready if the Free plan were shown to include service users.
